what: Pupils in letter holes (like the O O of LOOK) or in circle cells look toward the cursor if it moved within the last 1.8s (they travel less within 9x the cell width of distance, and follow each frame with 1−e^(−15·dt)). When the cursor rests, they look around slowly with two sines (1−e^(−6.5·dt)), look down for 1.1~2s every 5~11s, and blink for 190ms every 2.2~6.4s (closing fast, opening slowly, 28% of the time twice in a row — the eyelid comes down from the top to cover)

options.[data-fx-part=eye] > [data-fx-part=pupil: Eye slots (position and size set by the using side via style — fit them to the letter holes) and the pupils and eyelids inside (eyelids optional)
options.size: Pupil diameter (share of cell width), default .54 — set together with --fx-size in css
options.reach: Within this distance (multiple of cell width) it looks back less, default 9
options.gain: Strength of pull toward the cursor, default 1.5 (reaches the cell edge)
options.hold: Time (ms) after the cursor stops until it looks around again, default 1800
options.--fx-pupil: Pupil and eyelid color (via style), default --kf-ink — for pure-black text artwork, use that color

use: …
note: The eye cell’s left and top are the cell’s upper left (not center-based). With reduced motion the pupil stays at the center and does not blink

from.where: index.html .dl-mark (the two eyes in the middle line of the hero title — original tm-eye/tm-pupil/tm-lid, cursor 1800ms · follow 15 · look-around 6.5 · blink 190ms · double blink 28%)
